_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. Specs from Bugaboo's official Lynx spec page. Lynx is a distinct model from the Fox; sourced on its own merits. Now largely clearance/end-of-life at retail.
name: Bugaboo Lynx

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Lynx | Bugaboo Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Adapter for Maxi-Cosi | 441200MC01 or 231100MC02

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo lists 20.7 lb (9.4 kg) for chassis + wheels + seat; fully assembled ~23.9 lb (10.8 kg) per Bugaboo detailed spec / Strollberry.
specs._unfoldedNote: 31.1 x 23.62 x 38.98 in at lowest handlebar to 43.3 in at highest handlebar. Seat height ~22 in; footprint width ~20.5 in.
specs._foldedNote: One-piece self-standing fold 23.62 x 23.62 x 34.65 in. Two-piece compact fold 34.45 x 20.87 x 12.2 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (0 mo) — reversible seat reclines to a flat position and bassinet available for newborns; usable to ~4 yrs

specs._capacityNote: Max child height not published by Bugaboo. Underseat basket 22.05 lb (10 kg) / 36 L.

safety.standards: Not published on Bugaboo's Lynx spec page. Sold in the US, so it must meet the mandatory federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 (incorporates ASTM F833) to be marketed; EU units carry EN 1888. No explicit standard printed by the manufacturer, so not asserted as certified.
safety.certifications: No JPMA or Greenguard certification published for the Lynx on the manufacturer or retailer pages reviewed.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat with 3-position recline including flat; puncture-proof double-layer rubber tires. Adapter-mounted infant car seats limited to 28.7 lb child weight.

recall.source: CPSC/SaferProducts + Bugaboo product-recalls page; no recall listed for the Bugaboo Lynx

specs.foldType: one-hand fold; self-standing one-piece fold plus two-piece compact fold
specs.recline: 3-position recline including near-flat; reversible (facing parent or world)
specs.tires: puncture-proof double-layer rubber (foam-filled) wheels; front ~7 in, rear ~11 in; front swivel

notes: Distinct model from the Fox but shares the same Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Maxi-Cosi adapter (441200MC01, alternate 231100MC02) — adapter-441200mc01. Marketed by Bugaboo as its lightest FULL-SIZE stroller (~20.7 lb chassis+seat, ~23.9 lb fully assembled) with a reversible flat-reclining seat and puncture-proof tires. Full-size class, NOT a compact/city stroller; two-piece fold needed to get compact and it does not fold as small or light as a true travel stroller. STOCK: Lynx is largely end-of-life — out of stock at Bugaboo DTC (clearance $711.75, was $949) and Swaddles Baby ($849.20 sale, sold out); still listed in stock at ANB Baby ($949). Best cited price $711.75 (Bugaboo, out of stock); best in-stock $949 (ANB). Clek Liing mounts via the Maxi-Cosi-footprint adapter.
